name: 北欧简约折叠吧台酒柜款

shots.intent: 一眼读懂'一台柜子既是酒柜又是吧台'，用真实客厅角落建立点击理由与生活想象。
shots.textZone: top-centre headline 「{selling_point_1}」 at 40pt in #2D2D2D with a thin rule beneath

shots.intent: 把柜子放回真实餐厅墙面关系里，让买家核对进门后它的体积与搭配是否成立。
shots.textZone: left-side caption 「{callout_1}」 at 18pt in #2D2D2D over a thin rule

shots.intent: 先戳中小户型'酒和杯具没地方放'的痛点，用同一画面里的整柜解法逼出对比。
用同机位前后两态证明折叠收放，把'省地方还能坐两个人'变成看得见的对比。
shots.textZone: one label per panel: left 「{callout_3}」, right 「{callout_4}」, both at 14pt in #2D2D2D

shots.intent: 用侧掠光证明玻璃与镜面的通透和边框做工，把'卖相'变成可核验的工艺。
俯视交代菱形格与吊杯架的收纳结构，直接回答能放多少、怎么放。
shots.textZone: left column headline 「{callout_6}」 at 30pt in #2D2D2D with two thin-line icons and 12pt labels

shots.intent: 微距把台面木皮、封边与金属腿的真实质感交给买家，替掉材质疑虑。
shots.textZone: right-side material line 「{callout_7}」 at 14pt in #2D2D2D with one thin-line icon

shots.intent: 用正侧立面加占位标注把厚薄高宽交代清楚，解决'放不放得下'的最后一问。
shots.textZone: dimension leader lines in #2D2D2D with placeholder labels 「{callout_8}」 「{callout_9}」 「{callout_10}」 at 12pt

shots.intent: 把贴壁收拢与展开待客两个占地状态并置，让省空间的主张可被比较。
shots.textZone: left label 「{callout_11}」 and right label 「{callout_12}」 at 14pt in #2D2D2D, footprint outlines as thin dashed lines in #5A544E

shots.intent: 收口只讲可核验的产品事实，用结构与材质细节替代任何虚构背书。
shots.textZone: four single-weight thin-line icons in #2D2D2D in one row with four 12pt labels 「{callout_13}」 「{callout_14}」 「{callout_15}」 「{callout_16}」

style.backgroundSystem: real nordic apartment interior: matte off-white wall #F2EFEA, warm oak plank floor #C8A87C, one minimal framed art print or one potted green plant as depth cue, never a studio cyclorama, never a duplicated wall pattern
style.iconSystem: single-weight thin line icons in #2D2D2D, no fill, no gradient, same stroke width across the whole set
style.lightingSystem: cool 5500K daylight key from the left with a warm accent light inside the glazed upper compartment; raking side light on every glass panel, mirror shelf back and lattice rack so reflections and edges stay readable; soft believable contact shadows under legs and counter, no floating
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium Nordic-simple home furnishing visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of matte off-white wall #F2EFEA, warm grey-brown cabinet carcass #5A544E, light oak plank floor #C8A87C, and one warm brass accent #C9A15E; neutral temperature; modern geometric sans-serif with Chinese in-image copy wrapped in corner brackets; real nordic apartment interior backgrounds, never a studio cyclorama; soft 5500K daylight key from the left plus raking side light on glass, mirror and metal surfaces, warm accent light inside the glazed upper compartment; single-weight thin line icons in #2D2D2D; stable product scale with a real furniture or tableware anchor, corrected verticals, soft believable contact shadows; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented certifications or spec numbers.
noDrift: no duplicated artwork on the wall
no invented dimension numbers or material grades
style.presentationRules: the cabinet is always a complete free-standing unit on the floor with a real scale anchor (counter-height stool, wine bottle, or open magazine); the fold-down counter is either fully stowed or fully deployed, never mid-hinge; front facade stays parallel to the sensor with corrected verticals
style.surfaceSystem: matte timber-veneer cabinet carcass #5A544E with pale champagne inner shelves, thin dark metal bar-leg profile, oiled oak floor as the shared ground plane
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; headline 32-44pt, subtitle 18-20pt, label 12-14pt; Chinese in-image copy wrapped in 「」, max 50 characters per screen, thin hairline rules and bracketed corner marks as the only ornament
